about: Every sprite proposal made for Forest Survivor, in one place: the earlier Sprite Lab's (Codex's knight-motion work), the first proposals (once tools/lab), the ranger reworks and the standing studies (once tools/ranger-review), each built with the game's own sprite code. Frames sit left to right in each sheet; walk, idle and attack list them; anchorY is the row the feet stand on, as the game's sprites have it. A hero's entry has cls (its class); a monster's has as: "monster" and role (its part). collection says which batch it came from, origin where its code lived.

entries.name: Ironclad
entries.description: A squat brutal knight in thick iron plate: a compact flat-topped great helm with one narrow black slit, broad squared layered pauldrons, a visibly articulated waist and large gauntlets. A stout plain heater shield on the forward arm. Powerful compact proportions, calm planted ready stance.

entries.name: Blackguard
entries.description: An elegant dangerous gothic knight: a sharp sallet helmet and raised bevor with a single dark eye slit, swept angular shoulder plates, a narrow armoured waist and segmented greaves. A pointed kite shield on the forward arm. Slightly leaning forward in a disciplined duellist's ready stance, cleaner narrower silhouette than a tank.

entries.name: Sentinel
entries.description: A veteran shield knight: domed enclosed helmet with a bold T-shaped dark visor, rounded overlapping shoulder plates, a strong chest with one simple embossed vertical rib, thick dark joints and articulated sabatons. A small broad round shield with a central metal boss on the forward arm. Broad sturdy upper body, shorter compact legs, grounded confident ready stance.

entries.name: Gravewarden
entries.description: A menacing medieval dark-fantasy knight: a faceted close helmet whose visor evokes a stern skull through two dark recessed eye notches and a jaw-shaped steel bevor, restrained jagged overlapping shoulder plates, heavy fluted chest and squared boots. A tall rectangular iron pavise with a pointed lower edge on the forward arm. Threatening but believable forged armour, bold asymmetric silhouette, compact battle-ready stance.

entries.name: Remaster V1 · Knight
entries.description: Sir Aldric in silver plate under a red horsehair plume and cape: a T-visored armet, a red heater shield with a gold cross, the longsword low and forward. He breathes, plume and cape sway and the blade glints; the slash cocks the sword behind the helm and brings it over the top in a crescent, with a lunge.

entries.name: Remaster V1 · Ranger
entries.description: Lyra in a leaf-green hood and cloak over tan leather, a recurve longbow in the front hand and a fletched quiver on her back. She nocks, draws to the cheek and looses: the release is attack frame 4.

entries.name: Remaster V1 · Sorcerer
entries.description: Eldrin the Frost Archmage: a tall bent hat with a silver band, a long white beard, royal-blue robes with a silver-trimmed front and sash, a driftwood staff crowned with a glinting ice orb. He draws the staff back and thrusts it, and the orb bursts into a frost star.

entries.name: Remaster V1 · Shade
entries.description: Kael the Shade: a hooded wraith with a forward-hooked hood, two slanted glowing eyes, twin daggers and black-violet fire streaming off his shoulders, floating on a curling tail. He glides; his attack crosses two violet slashes as the fire flares.

entries.name: Remaster V1 · Necromancer
entries.description: Morvath the Blood Lich: a bone crown on a gaunt grey skull-face with burning eyes, a ribbed bone collar, a near-black robe traced with blood-red runes, a skull staff and an open grimoire. He raises the staff and the grimoire bursts into blood-red flame.

entries.name: Remaster V2 · Knight
entries.description: Sir Aldric en garde: a T-visored armet under a tall red horsehair plume, a fan-folded red cape, his red heater shield with its gold cross raised and the longsword levelled at the foe. He walks with sword and shield swinging against an 11 px stride; the slash cocks the blade behind the helm and brings it over the top in a crescent.

entries.name: Remaster V2 · Ranger
entries.description: Lyra in a leaf-green hood and cloak over tan leather, a tilted recurve longbow with a grey string, a fletched quiver. Wired for the game: she looses on attack frame 4 (frame 20) and shoots while walking (attackWalk, frames 22-69).

entries.name: Remaster V2 · Sorcerer
entries.description: Eldrin the Frost Archmage: a tall bent hat with a gold band over white brows, two eyes and a long white beard; royal-blue robes shaded as a cone; a driftwood staff with an ice orb he plants as he walks. His cast draws the staff back over his shoulder and thrusts it into a frost star around an ember core.

entries.name: Remaster V2 · Shadow
entries.description: Kael as a hooded assassin: a violet hood with two slanted glowing eyes over a mask, a magenta scarf streaming behind, twin daggers, a violet fire aura off his shoulders. He prowls on two legs; his attack crosses two white blade trails as the fire flares.

entries.name: Remaster V2 · Shade (wraith)
entries.description: Kael as the floating shade, rebuilt: a tall hooked hood over a void face with two slanted glowing eyes, shoulders and arms with twin daggers, a crown of violet fire rooted in the hood, a tail whose lowest wisp stays on the ground line. He glides; his attack crosses two white blade trails.

entries.name: Remaster V2 · Necromancer
entries.description: Morvath the Blood Lich: a spiked bone crown, a bone-grey skull face with acid-green eyes (the eye colour of his skeletons), bone pauldrons, a crimson robe darkening to a ragged blood-soaked hem with burning glyphs on a bone panel, a skull staff he plants as he walks and an open grimoire. His cast raises the staff and drives it down as the book bursts into blood flame.

entries.name: Remaster V3 · Knight
entries.description: Sir Aldric en garde: a T-visored armet under a tall red horsehair plume, a fan-folded red cape, his red heater shield with its gold cross raised and the longsword levelled at the foe; the plume and the cape keep moving through the whole idle. He walks with sword and shield swinging against an 11 px stride; the slash cocks a broad blade behind the helm with a motion streak and brings it over the top in a crescent.

entries.name: Remaster V3 · Ranger
entries.description: Lyra in a hunter's low ready: a leaf-green hood and cloak, feet wide and chin up, the recurve longbow held low and tipped forward with an arrow nocked and her near hand on the string; the hood tip, the cloak hem and the fletching sway through the idle. She draws to the cheek, and the release kicks the bow forward as the string hand flies back. She shoots while she walks.

entries.name: Remaster V3 · Sorcerer
entries.description: Eldrin the Frost Archmage, commanding: a tall bent hat with a gold band over scowling white brows and a long white beard, royal-blue robes shaded as a cone, the driftwood staff planted forward with its ice orb glinting, and his free hand raised with a pulsing ember. He walks with a small tome at his waist, planting the staff; his cast draws the staff back over his shoulder and thrusts it into a frost star around an ember core.

entries.name: Remaster V3 · Shadow
entries.description: Kael as a hooded assassin, in shadow: a dark plum hood whose point hooks forward over two slanted eyes that glow in the dark, a mask, a lilac rim of moonlight on his top-left edges, a magenta scarf streaming behind and burning out in a lick of violet fire, twin daggers, dark boots under light knee guards. He prowls on two legs; his attack crosses two white blade trails as the fire flares.

entries.name: Remaster V3 · Necromancer
entries.description: Morvath the Blood Lich: a spiked bone crown over a modelled skull with acid-green eyes in deep sockets (his skeletons' colour), bone pauldrons, a robe of crimson darkening to blood-black below the waist with glyphs burning on a bone panel, a skull staff whose eyes pulse and an open grimoire whose pages glow. His cast leans back with the book raised, then lunges as he drives the staff down through a wide arc and the book bursts into blood flame.

entries.name: Remaster V4 · Necromancer
entries.description: Morvath the Blood Lich: a spiked bone crown over a modelled skull with acid-green eyes (his skeletons' colour) in a black cowl, bone pauldrons, a blood-black robe lit only by a crimson rim, a blood-soaked hem and acid-green runes burning on a bone panel, a skull staff whose eyes pulse and an open grimoire whose glyphs glow. He walks planting the staff once a stride; his cast reads the spell off the burning pages, whips the staff over the top and drives it forward as acid-green soul fire blasts from its skull.

entries.name: Remaster V4 · Knight
entries.description: Sir Aldric en garde: a T-visored armet under a tall red horsehair plume, a fan-folded red cape, his red heater shield with its gold cross raised and the longsword levelled at the foe; the plume and the cape keep moving through the whole idle. He walks with sword and shield swinging against an 11 px stride; the slash cocks a broad blade behind the helm with a motion streak and brings it over the top in a crescent.

entries.name: Remaster V4 · Ranger
entries.description: Lyra in a hunter's low ready: a leaf-green hood with a sharp point, a cloak short at the front and long and tattered behind, a leather jerkin open over a pale linen shirt, feet wide and chin up, the recurve longbow held low and tipped forward with an arrow nocked and her near hand on the string; the hood tip, the cloak hem and the fletching sway through the idle. She draws to the cheek, and the release kicks the bow forward as the string hand flies back. She shoots while she walks.

entries.name: Remaster V4 · Sorcerer
entries.description: Eldrin the Frost Archmage, commanding: a tall bent hat with a gold band, frost-lit eyes glaring from the brim's shadow under scowling white brows, a long white beard, royal-blue robes shaded as a cone, the driftwood staff planted forward at a lean with its ice orb glinting, and his free hand raised to his head holding a flickering fire that lights his beard. He walks with a small tome at his waist, planting the staff; his cast draws the staff back over his shoulder and thrusts it into a frost star around an ember core.

entries.name: Remaster V4 · Shadow
entries.description: Kael as a hooded assassin, in shadow: a dark plum hood rising to a peak that hooks forward over two slanted eyes that glow in the dark, the scarf pulled up over his nose as a magenta mask, a lilac rim of moonlight on his top-left edges, the two tails of the scarf hanging down his back and burning out at their tips in a flicker of violet fire (streaming behind him when he moves), twin daggers and steel bracers, dark boots under light knee guards. He prowls on two legs; his attack coils both blades crossed in front of his chest, slashes down to the knee, then crosses two white blade trails.

entries.name: Remaster V5 · Necromancer
entries.description: Morvath the Blood Lich: a spiked bone crown over a modelled skull with acid-green eyes (his skeletons' colour) in a black cowl, bone pauldrons joined by a bone collar, a black robe lit only by a crimson rim, its hem torn into pointed tatters that drip crimson, acid-green runes burning on a bone panel kept in shadow below the skull, a skull staff whose eyes pulse and an open grimoire whose glyphs glow. He walks planting the staff once a stride, leaning into it; his cast reads the spell off the burning pages, whips the staff over the top and drives it forward as acid-green soul fire blasts from its skull.

entries.name: Remaster V5 · Knight
entries.description: Sir Aldric en garde: a T-visored armet under a tall red horsehair plume, a fan-folded red cape, his red heater shield with its gold cross raised and the longsword levelled at the foe; the plume sways through the whole idle and the cape billows back on his breath. He walks with sword and shield swinging against an 11 px stride; the slash cocks a broad blade behind the helm with a motion streak and brings it over the top in a crescent.

entries.name: Remaster V5 · Ranger
entries.description: Lyra in a hunter's low ready: a leaf-green hood with a sharp point, a cloak short at the front and long and tattered behind, a leather jerkin open over a pale linen shirt, feet wide and chin up, the recurve longbow held low and tipped forward with an arrow nocked and her near hand on the string; the hood tip, the cloak hem and the fletching sway through the idle, and a glint runs up the bow. She draws to the cheek, and the release kicks the bow forward as the string hand flies back. She shoots while she walks.

entries.name: Remaster V5 · Sorcerer
entries.description: Eldrin the Frost Archmage, commanding: a tall bent hat with a gold band, frost-lit eyes glaring from the brim's shadow under scowling white brows, a long white beard, royal-blue robes shaded as a cone, the driftwood staff planted forward at a lean with its ice orb glinting, and his free hand raised to his head holding a flickering fire that lights his beard. He walks planting the staff, the fire still flickering in his free hand at his waist; his cast draws the staff back over his shoulder and thrusts it into a frost star around an ember core.

entries.name: Remaster V5 · Shadow
entries.description: Kael as a hooded assassin, in shadow: a dark plum hood rising to a peak that hooks forward over two slanted eyes that glow in the dark, the scarf pulled up over his nose as a magenta mask, a lilac rim of moonlight on his top-left edges, the two tails of the scarf hanging down his back and burning out at their tips in a flicker of violet fire (on the move, a short stream rippling out behind his neck), twin daggers with a glint running up the raised one, steel bracers, dark boots under light knee guards. He prowls on two legs; his attack coils both blades crossed in front of his chest, slashes down to the knee, then crosses two white blade trails.

entries.name: Original · Sorcerer
entries.description: Eldrin as the game drew him until the remaster shipped: a frost archmage with a tall hat, a long white beard, blue robes and a staff crowned with an orb of ice.

entries.name: Original · Necromancer
entries.description: Morvath as the game drew him until the remaster shipped: a blood lich with a bone crown, a near-black robe traced with runes that burn blood red, and an open grimoire.

entries.name: Original · Shadow
entries.description: Kael as the game drew him until the Eclipse Wraith shipped: a gaunt dark-grey wraith with a pointed hood, slanted grey eyes and black flames rising off it.

entries.name: Ranger · Thornwarden
entries.description: A deep green hood shading the brow and cheek, a short mantle, leather armour and a bow held at rest. Standing proposal, both directions; no walk or attack animation.

entries.name: Mage · Ember Archmage
entries.description: A tapered wizard hat with a forward-bent tip and a narrower brim, a stern face and shorter beard, steel shoulders, blue and antique-gold robes, a planted staff and a flame in the free hand. Standing proposal, both directions; no walk or attack animation.

entries.name: Necromancer · Grave Regent
entries.description: A fitted ash-violet hood, bone pauldrons over a split crimson robe, a green-eyed skull and a forward-leaning skull staff. Standing proposal, both directions; no walk or attack animation.

entries.name: Necromancer · Ossuary King
entries.description: An exposed crowned skull, broad spiked bone pauldrons, a dark ribbed cuirass, ash-green robes and a hooked soul staff. An alternative to the hooded Grave Regent. Standing proposal, both directions; no walk or attack animation.

entries.name: Ranger · Greenhood
entries.description: The classic hooded ranger, done right: a bright pointed hood whose lit rim frames a clear face, a dark braid, a dagged capelet and red-fletched arrows over the shoulder. Replaces the cap-like hood, hidden face and claw-like arrows with one clean silhouette and a bow held at the grip.

entries.name: Ranger · Copper Tail
entries.description: Hood down: a copper ponytail tied in green falls down her back like the knight's plume, over a leaf-cut capelet, leather and dark green leggings. Warm and cool blocks alternate as on the knight, so she reads at a glance instead of as a muddy brown figure.

entries.name: Ranger · Mossmantle
entries.description: A deep olive hood lined in crimson frames her face, with a gold clasp, a long mossy cloak thrown back and a crimson grip on the bow. Fixes Thornwarden's hidden face and loose cape: the red lining is the one focal accent, and the cloak hangs from the hood as one shape.

entries.name: Ranger · Silverleaf
entries.description: An elven huntress: silver hair, a long pointed ear, a teal leaf mantle and a pale birch bow whose moonstone glows at night. A cool, light silhouette that stands out on the dark forest floor, unlike the brown and olive rangers before her.

entries.name: Mage · Grand Archmage
entries.description: The classic Eldrin rebuilt: brim, band and cone all centred on the skull, the brim dipping over the brow onto white hair and throwing a shadow on stern V-brows, a long beard hanging from the chin, an ember orb in a gold cup and a white-hot fireball in his raised hand.

entries.name: Mage · Battlemage
entries.description: A grizzled war-wizard: a battered leather hat worn low, its brim centred and its tip folded forward, a crimson coat with a baldric, a steel pauldron and bracer, a fireball held forward on an open palm and an iron-crowned staff planted behind, in a wide stride like the knight's.

entries.name: Mage · Ember Prodigy
entries.description: A young fire sorcerer: a straight plum hat with a gold flame emblem, seated on swept-back red hair that fills the back of the brim, stern brows in its shadow, a fitted coat with gold lapels, a fireball raised high and a gold-ring ember staff.

entries.name: Mage · Ashen Pyromancer
entries.description: A mysterious ash-grey pyromancer: a wide slouched hat, centred on the head, throws the face into shadow so only two ember eyes show above a red scarf; he cups a flame before his chest, carries a caged-lantern staff, and his hem smoulders.

entries.name: Necromancer · Gravecaller
entries.description: A violet hood with a swept-back peak and a forward brim hides the face but for two green eyes and a glint of jaw; a ragged mantle, a cloak trailing behind with its green lining turned out at the tears, and a bell sleeve reaching to a skull staff crowned with soul fire. Fixes the box skull, the floating pauldrons, the cake-like grimoire and the comb hem with one clean silhouette lit from the upper left, its glow kept at the face and the staff.

entries.name: Necromancer · Bone Tyrant
entries.description: A death lord in lilac-black plate: bone horns off an iron helm over a skull face with green eyes, spiked pauldrons, a ribcage cuirass, a wine cape and tabard over a wide armoured stance, and a staff whose bone prongs cradle a soul orb. Bone appears only as sharp accents on dark armour, so he reads as the master of the skeletons rather than one of them.

entries.name: Necromancer · Grave Warden
entries.description: A plague-doctor gravekeeper: a black wide-brimmed hat and feathered capelet frame a bird-skull mask with a green lens, over a teal coat with bone buttons and a skull charm, and a crook from which hangs a lantern of soul fire. The most distinctive silhouette of the set, with the lantern as its focal glow and no shape shared with any monster.

entries.name: Necromancer · Soulflame
entries.description: A lich whose bare skull burns with green soul fire, three tongues streaming back like the knight’s plume, in midnight-navy robes with a gold-trimmed mantle, a gold-edged front flap and hem, a belt of vertebrae, bone feet and a sickle-headed staff. The fire is the focal point and still reads at 1x, and at night it glows on its own.

entries.name: Necromancer · Blood Lich Reforged
entries.description: The Blood Lich in the game now, with its weirdness fixed: a rounded three-quarter skull under a black iron crown with a soul gem, the cowl draped behind the head, blood-wine robes deeper than the knight’s red, a staff gripped by a visible hand, and an open grimoire whose green fire rises from its gutter. The closest of the five to what ships today.

entries.name: Sorcerer · Grand Archmage (picked)
entries.description: The Grand Archmage in the colours picked on the review page (hue -9, colour +41, brightness -4, contrast +21, midtones +23, warmth +40, tint -15, outline -100), animated for the game: he breathes as the fireball in his hand flickers; he walks with the hem of his robe swinging and kicking up over each stride, his boots stepping under it, the staff planted and swung forward and the fire streaming back; and his cast swells the fire to a blaze that flings embers.

entries.name: Sorcerer · Grand Archmage (animated)
entries.description: The Grand Archmage in his own colours, animated as the picked one is.

entries.name: Necromancer · Soulflame (picked)
entries.description: Soulflame in the colours picked on the review page (hue +1, colour +69, brightness +11, warmth +29, tint +46, outline -100), the flames gone and a lich king's gold crown with a soul gem on his bare skull, animated for the game: breathing with the mantle settling and the gem pulsing, a walk that plants and vaults the sickle staff with the hem swinging over stepping bone feet, and a cast that lifts the staff as soul light bursts from the sickle.

entries.name: Necromancer · Soulflame (animated)
entries.description: Soulflame crowned, in his own colours, animated as the picked one is.

entries.name: Ranger · Silverleaf (picked)
entries.description: Silverleaf in the colours picked on the review page (hue -19, colour +22, brightness -11, contrast +14, midtones +37, warmth +40, tint +11, outline -100), animated for the game. Her silver hair is drawn back from the parted fringe, over the long pointed ear, into a high ponytail tied in gold. She breathes as the tail settles; walks with a planted stride, the body bobbing and the tail trailing; and shoots: lifts the bow, nocks, draws to the chin, holds, looses with the string snapping forward, follows through and lowers, standing or on the move.

entries.name: Ranger · Silverleaf (animated)
entries.description: Silverleaf in her own colours, with the same ponytail and the same breathing, walk and shots as the picked one.

entries.name: Original · Lyra (until 15 October)
entries.description: The ranger the game drew until Silverleaf was picked: hooded, in green and leather, with her bow shots and shots on the move.

entries.name: Berserker · v1
entries.description: Ulfric the Berserker: a broad northman under a grey wolf pelt whose head sits over his brow, a braided red beard with a gold ring, bare arms banded in blue woad, leather bracers, a leather kilt and fur-wrapped boots, a hand axe in each fist. He leaps and brings both axes down in a double chop.

entries.name: Paladin · v1
entries.description: Dame Seraphine, a holy warrior in pearl-white plate trimmed in gold: an open-faced helm with a sun gem on its brow, a copper ponytail, a white tabard with a glowing gold sun, a short cream cape, and a heavy warhammer held upright like a standard. She walks with the hammer carried upright and her free arm swinging; her Smite lifts the hammer into a sunburst, brings it over in a gold crescent and slams it down in a burst of holy light.

entries.name: Druid · v1
entries.description: Bramwyn the Druid: pale antlers forking out of a wreath of autumn leaves on a bark-brown hood, an ash-grey beard, a mantle of gold, orange and rust leaves over a knee-length bark robe with a mossy hem, linen-wrapped legs, and a gnarled staff whose root-claw holds a glowing amber seed-crystal. He drives the staff into the ground and thorny roots burst up round it.

entries.name: Witch Hunter · v1
entries.description: Mercy Crane, a grim hunter in a wide-brimmed black capotain with a silver buckle, a long blue-black frock coat split into tails, a white falling-band collar, a bandolier of silver bolts and tall cuffed boots, her heavy crossbow levelled at the hip. She brings it to the shoulder, looses with a snap, rides the recoil and cranks the windlass to span it again.

entries.name: Knight · B
entries.description: A weathered knight-errant in blued steel: a flat-topped great helm with a T-visor and a brass brow band, a gold tabard with a navy chevron, a navy kite shield with the gold chevron slung on his back, and a broad longsword held up and forward in guard. He walks with the sword kept in guard; his cut raises it overhead, brings it over the top in a white crescent, sweeps it forward and down, and recovers to guard.

entries.name: Knight · Ember
entries.description: The Ember Knight: a hot-headed young knight forged in a volcano. A blackened-brass sallet with a living flame for a crest and two big glowing eyes, crimson plate cracked with glowing seams, a scorched half-cape and no shield, one broad flamberge whose edges glow ember-orange, carried low and forward with a swagger. His cut rears the blade back over the helm, brings it over in a blazing crescent that leaves sparks, sweeps it down in front and recovers.

entries.name: Knight · Frost Warden
entries.description: A northern guardian from the frozen peaks: pale ice-blue enamel plate with silver trim, a shaggy white wolf-fur mantle round his shoulders, an open helm with two swept-back silver wings over a small stern face with icy eyes, a round shield of blue ice carrying a glowing snowflake, and a crystal longsword held upright beside his head. He walks with the sword raised; his cut lifts the blade over the helm, sweeps it forward in a wide cold arc that sheds ice shards and snow, and brings it back to guard.

entries.name: Knight · Black Knight
entries.description: A brooding little tyrant in jagged obsidian plate: a closed helm with two curved horns and two glowing red eyes in its visor slit, spiky pauldrons, a tattered blood-red cloak that streams behind him, and a jagged greatsword held up before him in both hands, its edge a glowing red saw. He walks with the blade rocking, cloak flapping; his cut swings it back, brings it over in a dark-red crescent, slams it down and lifts it to guard again.

entries.name: Knight · Thorn Knight
entries.description: A guardian of the ancient forest: dark bark armour with moss-green lacquered plates, small leaves and tiny pink flowers growing from the joints, a round helm with branching antlers (one carries a leaf) and glowing green eyes in a dark visor, a teal leaf-shaped cape and a round wooden shield with a carved tree slung on his back, and a bronze leaf-bladed sword wound with a glowing vine. He walks with the sword in guard and blinks now and then; his cut lifts the sword behind the antlers, whips a bright green arc overhead and down in front, shedding leaves, and settles back to guard.

entries.name: Knight · Moon Knight
entries.description: A slim night-sky paladin in deep violet and moon-silver plate: a sleek domed helm with a silver crescent-moon crest (a star twinkling in its mouth) and a narrow glowing silver-blue visor, a midnight-blue surcoat with a glowing crescent sigil, a long star-scattered cloak with a violet lining, a small crescent buckler on the sword forearm and a slim curved moon-steel sabre with a pale glow. He walks with the sabre in guard and the cloak trailing; his cut draws the sabre back over the shoulder, brings it over the top in a moonlight crescent, lunges through it with sparkles flying and recovers to guard.

entries.name: Ranger · Knight style A
entries.description: Lyra redrawn in the plumed Knight's style: no black outline (every edge is the darkest shade of its own material), about three heads tall, a pixel shorter and visibly slimmer than the Knight, shaded with 7-step hue-shifted ramps (green leaning teal in shadow and moss-gold in light, silver hair leaning purple and pink). Forest green hooded cloak and tunic over a leather jerkin, silver high ponytail, long elf ear, pale yew longbow, amber accents and a moonstone clasp. She breathes as the cloak stirs and the tail sways; walks leaning into a planted stride, the cloak streaming and the tail trailing; and shoots: lifts, nocks, draws to the chin, holds, looses with the string snapping and a white swoosh, follows through and lowers, standing or on the move.

entries.name: Ranger · Knight style B
entries.description: Lyra redrawn in the plumed Knight's manner: no black outline (every edge a dark shade of its own material), hue-shifted ramps (silver hair that shades violet and lights pink, forest green from blue-black to yellow-green, violet-brown leather), about 3 heads tall and a touch shorter and slimmer than the Knight. A high silver ponytail tied in gold and a green cape flow behind her: they ripple in her breathing idle, stream back on her planted, bobbing walk and are flung back by the shot. She lifts the bow, nocks, draws to the chin with the elbow out behind, holds (the arrowhead glints), looses with the string snapping forward and a white crescent and streak flying out, follows through and lowers, standing or on the move. The moonstone in the grip and the arrowhead glow.

entries.name: Ranger · Knight style C (Hooded)
entries.description: Style B with a ranger’s hood: Lyra wears a deep-green hood up over her head, joined to her cape by a shoulder mantle pinned with a gold clasp at the throat. The hood is the head’s shape now: its long pointed tail rises off the crown and falls down her back, swaying in her breathing idle, streaming back on the walk and flung back by the shot, as the plumed Knight’s plume does. Under the lit brim a fringe of silver hair and a lock by the cheek show, with her face in 3/4 (teal eye, nose, skin). The cloak (hood, mantle, cape) is a deeper, cooler green than the tunic so the two read apart. As on the Knight there is no black outline (every edge a dark shade of its own material) and the ramps are hue-shifted. She lifts the bow, nocks, draws to the chin (her hand on the nock, the elbow out behind the hood), holds (the arrowhead glints), looses with the string snapping forward and a white crescent and streak flying out, follows through and lowers, standing or on the move. The moonstone in the grip and the arrowhead glow.

entries.name: Ranger · Knight style D (Pokémon)
entries.description: Style B shifted a bit toward a Gen 4-5 Pokémon trainer sprite, still in the plumed Knight's manner (no black outline: every edge the darkest tone of its own material). A slightly larger, rounder head with the silver fringe swept off a readable face: a big eye (dark lid, a white glint, teal iris), the far eye on the face's edge, a light nose and a small smile, and a pointed elf ear laid back past the hair. Clean, bright colour blocks in 3-4 flat tones per material (29 colours): a bright green tunic against a darker green cape and cowl, lavender-silver hair, warm leather, gold accents. A big high ponytail tied in gold arcs back like the Knight's plume and, with the cape, ripples in her breathing idle, streams back on her bobbing walk and is flung back by the shot. She lifts the bow, nocks, draws with her elbow up behind and her gloved hand at the jaw, holds (the arrowhead glints), looses with the string snapping forward and a white crescent and streak flying out, follows through and lowers, standing or on the move. The moonstone in the grip and the arrowhead glow.

entries.name: Ranger · Knight style E (Hooded Pokémon)
entries.description: Lyra built on Style B (no black outline, every edge a dark shade of its own material; the sweeping cape, the lean, the slim build, the release burst) with her ranger's hood up and drawn a bit toward a Gen 4-5 Pokémon trainer sprite: a rounder, larger hooded head, a big bright teal eye with a white highlight, a friendly face framed by a silver fringe and lock, her long elf ear poking out through the hood, and clean 3-4 tone colour blocks (a bright green hood, mantle and cape over a cream linen tunic, a brown belt with a gold buckle, dark leather breeches and tan boots). The hood's pointed tail and the cape ripple in her breathing idle, trail back on her bobbing walk and are flung back by the shot. She lifts the bow, nocks, draws to the cheek (the string and arrow run behind her face, the elbow out behind her hood), holds (the arrowhead glints), looses with the string snapping forward and a white crescent and streak flying out, follows through and lowers, standing or on the move. The moonstone in the grip and the arrowhead glow.

entries.name: Ranger · Knight style F (C refined)
entries.description: Style C (hooded Lyra) refined to sit closer to the plumed Knight. Same design: the deep-green hood with its long flowing tail, the mantle and gold clasp, the slim build, the cape, silver fringe and a readable 3/4 face. Rendered the Knight’s way: long hue-shifted ramps (cloak from indigo-black through blue-teal to a warm yellow-green sheen, a lighter leaf-green tunic, leather from violet-brown to ochre), every silhouette pixel in its material’s darkest shade with no black line, 1 px detail on the bow (lit belly, wrapped grip, gold bands and nock caps), the leaf-shaped clasp, the fletched arrow with its steel head, and the face (navy lid, white, teal iris, a nose a pixel proud). She leans a pixel forward; folds ripple down the cape, its inner lobe falls over the far leg, and the hood tail sways a beat behind, so the outline changes frame to frame. The loose throws a long white crescent of light (24 px, 6-7 px deep at its belly, fading to lilac) out of the frame with the string’s snap, as big as the Knight’s sword swoosh. The moonstone in the grip and the arrowhead glow.

entries.name: Ranger · Knight style G (C with an accent)
entries.description: Style C given the plumed Knight’s colour logic: one main material (the forest-green hood, mantle and cape, now with near-black teal shadows and a bright moss light for higher contrast on dark grass) and ONE strong saturated accent, a crimson scarf in a deep wine-to-hot-red ramp. It is wound at her throat under the chin, pinned with a gold clasp, and its two long ends stream back over the cape the way his plume and cape do: rippling in the breathing idle, streaming level on the walk and flung back by the loose. The same crimson lines the hood’s brim beside her face, fletches the arrow and wraps the bow grip. She leans a pixel forward with a wider stance, for his dynamic posture. Everything C is liked for stays: the hood with its flowing pointed tail, the readable face under silver strands, the slim build, the cape and the big white release. No black outline (each edge a dark shade of its own material), hue-shifted ramps. The moonstone in the grip and the arrowhead glow.

entries.name: Sorcerer · Knight style A (Classic)
entries.description: Eldrin as he is today, redrawn in the plumed Knight’s style: an old wizard in a blue robe and a tall pointed blue hat with a gold band, a long white beard and white hair, a wooden staff crowned with a glowing fire orb in a gold claw, and a flame burning over his open palm. No black outline (every edge a dark tone of its own material), blue ramps that run from violet shadow to cyan-white light, a pale lining at the robe’s opening, and fire as the one accent. The hat’s floppy point sways and blows back like the Knight’s plume, the robe tapers at the belt and its back hem ripples and trails like his cape, and beard, hair and bell sleeves swing a beat behind. His attack gathers fire in the palm, swings it up behind his head as it swells into a blazing ball, and hurls it overhand in a big fiery crescent that flies off to the right, breaking into embers as he recovers. The fire (hand flame, staff orb, fireball and crescent) glows.

entries.name: Sorcerer · Knight style B (Battle mage)
entries.description: Eldrin redrawn as a leaner battle-sorcerer in the plumed Knight’s spirit: an old wizard with a white beard and brows, in a deep-indigo battle coat with a long back tail, a wide rakish brim on a swept-back pointed hat with a brass band, and a crimson scarf whose two long ends stream behind him the way the Knight’s plume and cape do. He leans into his stance with his casting hand held out, a flame licking on the palm; his staff, crowned with a clawed fire orb, rests slanted over his shoulder from the near hand at his hip. Fire is the one strong accent, one ramp from the scarf’s near-black red to the flame’s white core. His idle breathes (the scarf ripples, the coat tail lifts, the hat tip and beard lag a beat); on the walk the scarf and coat stream back and the flame leans away. The cast: he draws the flame in, raises it into a fireball over the brim while leaning back, then lunges and hurls it forward at the head of a blazing arc (frame 19), the ball flying on as a comet while the arc breaks into embers, and the flame rekindles in his palm. No black outline: every edge is a dark tone of its own material. The flames, the fireball, the arc and the orb glow.

entries.name: Sorcerer · Knight style A (both eyes)
entries.description: Eldrin as he is today, redrawn in the plumed Knight’s style: an old wizard in a blue robe and a tall pointed blue hat with a gold band, a long white beard and white hair, a wooden staff crowned with a glowing fire orb in a gold claw, and a flame burning over his open palm. No black outline (every edge a dark tone of its own material), blue ramps that run from violet shadow to cyan-white light, a pale lining at the robe’s opening, and fire as the one accent. The hat’s floppy point sways and blows back like the Knight’s plume, the robe tapers at the belt and its back hem ripples and trails like his cape, and beard, hair and bell sleeves swing a beat behind. His head is turned a little toward the viewer, so both eyes show under his bushy white brows, with the bridge of his big nose between them and the beard hanging from the turned chin. His attack gathers fire in the palm, swings it up behind his head as it swells into a blazing ball, and hurls it overhand in a big fiery crescent that flies off to the right, breaking into embers as he recovers. The fire (hand flame, staff orb, fireball and crescent) glows.

entries.name: Shadow · Knight style A (Assassin)
entries.description: Kael as a hooded human assassin in the plumed Knight’s style: near-black purple leathers under an indigo cowl whose peak leans back and whose back drapes onto his shoulders, a plum scarf wound round his throat and up over his nose and mouth as a mask, and one glowing violet eye under the brim. The scarf’s two long tattered tails trail behind him as the Knight’s plume and cape do, rippling in his breathing idle and streaming back on the walk, with short split coat tails flapping below them. He carries twin daggers with 1 px bright edges and violet gem pommels: the near one low and forward, point up, the far one reversed behind his hip. No black outline (every edge a dark tone of its own material) and hue-shifted ramps: blue-black shadows, cool lavender lights. His attack crouches and draws both blades back, coils with one blade behind his head, whips both arms forward over his head (a violet arc), then throws: the daggers fly apart point first, up and down, at the heads of two sharp pale-violet streaks that cross in an X before him; he spins round through two violet rings and lands back in his stance with fresh blades and a glint. The eye, the pommel gems, the streaks and the rings glow.

entries.name: Shadow · Knight style B (Wraith)
entries.description: Kael as a wraith in the plumed Knight’s style: a slim assassin in a deep violet cowl and a long cloak whose hem tears into tongues that thin, dissolve and shed drifting flecks, with a scarf wound to the chin whose two tails stream back from his nape like the Knight’s plume, rippling and fraying at their ends. In the hood’s shadow a pale bone mask with one glowing moon-lilac eye. He walks on slim slate legs (no floating), a dagger forward in his near hand, another held low behind. As on the Knight there is no black outline (every edge a dark tone of its own material) and the ramps are hue-shifted: indigo shadows, magenta-pink lights on the violet. The attack is a double throw: a crouch with the blades crossed, both arms cocked back over the shoulder, a pale-violet crescent swoosh over his head as they whip forward, then (frame 19) two daggers fly out with long glowing streaks, he spins back inside a ring of light and draws new blades. The eye, the blade edges and points and the streaks glow at night.

entries.name: Necromancer · Knight style A (Classic)
entries.description: A faithful redraw of Morvath in the plumed Knight’s style: a skull in 3/4 under a three-pointed gold crown with a green soul gem, both sockets lit by green soulfire, a navy capelet trimmed in gold with a clasp at the throat, a purple-navy robe with a gold-edged front and a ragged hem, bone feet stepping under it, and a long tattered mantle that ripples in his breathing idle and streams back on the walk. He carries a crooked dark staff whose hook cradles a flickering soulfire. As on the Knight there is no black outline (every edge a dark tone of its own material) and the ramps are hue-shifted (blue-black shadows, pink-violet lights). His cast: soulfire kindles and is drawn in, he raises the staff as it gathers into an orb, it bursts on the fourth frame into a big green flare (a white-hot core, rays and a ring) while the dead’s fire bursts from the ground ahead of him, then the ring flies apart into sparks, the wisps rise and he lowers the staff. The eyes, the crown gem, the staff’s soulfire and the cast glow.

entries.name: Necromancer · Knight style B (Grave lord)
entries.description: Morvath as a gaunt grave lord in the plumed Knight’s style: a deep black-violet hood ringed by a crown of bone tines with a green soul-gem, the skull face inside lit from below by the soul-gem clasp at his throat (two green eyes, cheekbones, teeth), leaning forward over his staff. A bone-spined mantle and a long tattered cloak torn into strips stream behind him and ripple in his breathing idle, trail level on the gliding walk and are flung back by the cast. His staff is black wood bound with bone, a small skull at its head with soulfire on it and a scythe blade curving forward. He draws the staff back as green sparks gather, thrusts it up and forward as the soulfire swells, bursts into a great green flare (frame 19) while soulfire and a bony hand break from the ground ahead, then the flare fades to sparks and the staff comes down. No black outline: every edge a dark tone of its own material, hue-shifted ramps. The soulfire greens glow at night.

entries.name: Paladin · Knight style A (Classic)
entries.description: Dame Seraphine redrawn in the plumed Knight’s style: a white veil over a gold circlet with a holy gem, falling down her back and swaying in her breathing idle, streaming on the walk and flung back by the blow, as the Knight’s plume and cape do; silver plate with hue-shifted blue-violet shadows and warm cream lights, a white tabard with a gold sun, a gold belt and a tabard skirt that swings with the stride; a small 3/4 face under the veil. She holds her warhammer upright at her side. Smite: she gathers light at her chest, heaves the hammer up behind her head, brings it over the top in a blazing gold-white arc and slams it down in front of her (frame 19): a flash, rays, a ground flare and a pillar of holy light to the sky, which thins into rising sparks as she lifts the hammer back. No black outline: every edge is a dark tone of its own material. The holy light, the circlet gem and the sun’s heart glow.

entries.name: Paladin · Knight style B (Crusader)
entries.description: Dame Seraphine as a crusader knight in the plumed Knight’s style: a sleek silver sallet with a swept silver wing on its side and a gold brow band, her face showing (blue eye), polished silver plate under a white crusader tabard with a gold cross and gold belt, a gold-rimmed pauldron, a white veil from under the helm and a long white cape lined in gold that streams and ripples like the Knight’s red one. She carries a silver-and-gold warhammer low before her, its head haloed in holy light (a shimmering rim and a circling mote). Her smite draws the hammer back low, hoists it overhead, swings it over the top in a gold smear and brings it down on frame 19 in a broad gold-to-white-hot crescent, with a pillar of light falling on the foe ahead, a white flash and rays bursting from the impact and a shock along the ground; then the pillar breaks into white-hot sparks and she recovers. No black outline (every edge a dark tone of its own material), hue-shifted ramps; the halo and the smite light glow at night.

entries.name: Paladin · Knight style C (barrel helm)
entries.description: Dame Seraphine as a crusader knight in the plumed Knight’s style (style B reworked at the head): a flat-topped cylindrical barrel helm with a gold band right across it and a small swept silver wing crest on its side, her face showing (blue eye) in a small opening at its front, polished silver plate under a white crusader tabard with a gold cross and gold belt, a gold-rimmed pauldron, a white veil from under the helm and a long white cape lined in gold that streams and ripples like the Knight’s red one. She carries a silver-and-gold warhammer low before her, its head haloed in holy light (a shimmering rim and a circling mote). Her smite draws the hammer back low, hoists it overhead, swings it over the top in a gold smear and brings it down on frame 19 in a broad gold-to-white-hot crescent, with a pillar of light falling on the foe ahead, a white flash and rays bursting from the impact and a shock along the ground; then the pillar breaks into white-hot sparks and she recovers. Her head is a short upright cylinder, a little taller than wide, with square corners, a flat top in its own light tone and cylinder shading (a light band toward the upper-left light, the front in shade), set apart from the shoulders by a dark steel gorget: the neck is narrower than the helm, and the shoulder line dips in under it. No black outline (every edge a dark tone of its own material), hue-shifted ramps; the halo and the smite light glow at night.

entries.name: Paladin · Knight style D (squared hood)
entries.description: Dame Seraphine redrawn in the plumed Knight’s style (Style A with a reworked head): a squared white hood with a gold circlet and a holy gem, its veil falling from behind it down her back, swaying in her breathing idle, streaming on the walk and flung back by the blow, as the Knight’s plume and cape do; silver plate with hue-shifted blue-violet shadows and warm cream lights, a white tabard with a gold sun, a gold belt and a tabard skirt that swings with the stride. Her head is a short upright cylinder with a flat crown, straight sides and 1 px cut corners, shaded as a cylinder and framing a small 3/4 face; it stands on a dark steel gorget neck above her collar and shoulders, so it reads as its own shape and not as a round lump on her body. She holds her warhammer upright at her side. Smite: she gathers light at her chest, heaves the hammer up behind her head, brings it over the top in a blazing gold-white arc and slams it down in front of her (frame 19): a flash, rays, a ground flare and a pillar of holy light to the sky, which thins into rising sparks as she lifts the hammer back. No black outline: every edge is a dark tone of its own material. The holy light, the circlet gem and the sun’s heart glow.

entries.name: Druid · Knight style A (Classic)
entries.description: Bramwyn redrawn in the plumed Knight's style: a bearded forest druid in a deep brown hood with pale antlers rising from a small wreath of rust and green leaves, a white-grey beard falling over brown robes, a rust collar and a long rust mantle flowing behind him, a green leaf skirt over linen-wrapped legs, and a gnarled staff whose claw holds a glowing golden seed. No black outline: every edge is a dark tone of its own material, with hue-shifted ramps (purple-brown shadows, warm ochre lights). He breathes in his idle while the mantle and the leaf hem ripple and the staff rocks; on the walk the staff is planted, then swung forward, and the mantle streams back. His attack lifts the staff, raises it high behind the antlers with the seed blazing, drives it down in a golden arc, and strikes the ground: a dome of green-gold light and rays bursts up and roots break from the earth, grow, and sink back as the light breaks into sparks. The seed's light, the arc and the burst glow at night.

entries.name: Druid · Knight style B (Forest spirit)
entries.description: A freer, feral Bramwyn in the plumed Knight’s style: a lean druid wrapped in a moss-green cloak of leaves whose rim is cut into leaf points and whose cloth is laid in leaf scales; it ripples in his breathing idle, streams back on his prowling walk and tears off leaves that drift away, as the Knight’s cape and plume flow. He wears a deer skull over brow and nose, branching bone antlers rising from it and a gold eye glinting in its socket, an ash beard below, a hood of leaves behind, bark-wrapped legs. His gnarled living-wood staff cradles a glowing gold seed in a claw of twigs, the one warm accent. No black outline (every edge a dark tone of its own material) and hue-shifted ramps (teal shadows, yellow-green lights; violet-grey to cream bone). His strike: he sinks and grips the staff in both hands, heaves it up with the seed blazing, drives it down in streaks of light, and slams its foot into the ground ahead: a dome of green-gold light, a ring along the ground and rays burst up, then curling roots shoot up with leaf tips and sink back as motes drift. The seed, the eye and the strike’s light glow.

entries.name: Berserker · Knight style A (Classic)
entries.description: A faithful redraw of Ulfric in the plumed Knight’s style. He wears a grey-brown wolf’s head as a hood (ears up, the snout and fangs over his brow, an amber wolf’s eye), and its pelt runs on down his back into a two-lobed fur cape with the wolf’s pale-tipped tail swinging beneath it. Under the snout: a shadowed brow, a pale fierce eye and a big red beard braided through a gold ring, the one strong accent. Bare, heavy arms in sun-browned skin with leather bracers, a dark leather jerkin with a strap and gold stud, a belt and a kilt of leather strips, fur-wrapped shins. Broader and heavier than the Knight at the Knight’s height. He holds two bearded axes up and out, ready; their steel heads carry a 1 px bright edge. Idle: a heavy breath with the cape rippling and the tail swaying a beat behind. Walk: a planted stride, the axes swinging against the legs, cape and tail streaming. Attack: he gathers, raises both axes overhead, cocks them back behind his head, then crashes them down on frame 19 inside a wide white crescent, the axes biting the ground and throwing up chips, and recovers. No black outline: every edge is a dark tone of its own material, all ramps hue-shifted.

entries.name: Berserker · Knight style B (Raider)
entries.description: Ulfric as a Norse raider in the plumed Knight’s style: bare-headed, with long red hair that streams back off his crown and a thin braid with an iron bead, a braided red beard down his chest, and a band of blue-grey war paint across his eyes and round his bare, muscled upper arms. A heavy fur cape and a fur mantle over the shoulders, a brown leather jerkin with an iron band and an iron belt, fur-wrapped boots, a savage forward lean, and a bearded axe in each fist (one raised forward, one trailing behind). As on the Knight there is no black outline (every edge a dark shade of its own material) and the ramps are hue-shifted, cool purple in the shadows and warm in the light; the red hair and paint are the one accent. His hair, braid and cape sway in a heavy breathing idle and stream back on the walk. The attack is a two-axe overhead chop: he rears back with both axes up, swings them over the top, crashes them down in front on the release frame with a wide white crescent, bites the ground in a spray of chips and recovers.

entries.name: Witch Hunter · Knight style A (Classic)
entries.description: A faithful redraw of Mercy Crane in the plumed Knight’s style: a wide-brimmed grey felt hat with a red band and a brass buckle, brown hair falling to her shoulders, a long grey-blue frock coat buttoned in silver over a white falling-band collar, a belt with a brass buckle, charcoal breeches and tall leather boots, and a silver crossbow with a walnut stock. As on the Knight there is no black outline (every edge a dark shade of its own material) and the ramps are hue-shifted, cool violet in the shadows and warm grey-pink in the lights. The coat’s tails flap out behind her as his cape does and her hair sways, rippling in the breathing idle and streaming back on the walk. She raises the crossbow, aims it at the shoulder, holds while the bolt’s silver head glints, and looses on frame 19: a white flash bursts at the prod and a thick silver streak flies out of the frame, the recoil kicking the nose up, rocking her back and jolting her hat; the streak breaks into dashes and she spans the string again. The silver bolt head glows at night.

entries.name: Witch Hunter · Knight style B (Inquisitor)
entries.description: Mercy Crane as a grim inquisitor in the plumed Knight’s style: a tall-crowned slate hat with a crimson band and a silver buckle, its brim dipping over her eyes, a dark slate long coat whose split tails stream behind her like the Knight’s cape, and a crimson scarf whose long ends fly back from the nape like his plume (crimson is the one strong accent). Brown hair tied back, a small grim face in profile, a leather baldric with silver buckles, tall black boots. She carries a heavy ornate silver crossbow at the hip (a three-pixel recurved silver prod, a silver-railed walnut stock with inlay and a crimson stone). As on the Knight there is no black outline (every edge a dark tone of its own material) and the ramps are hue-shifted. Her idle breathes while the scarf and coat tails ripple; on the walk they stream back. Attack: she swings the crossbow up, shoulders it and leans in, the bolt head glints, then the bolt leaves on attack index 3 as a bright silver streak with a white flash off the snapping prod while the recoil kicks the nose up and the scarf is flung back; the streak breaks up and she lowers the crossbow to span it again. The silver bolt head glows at night.
